place: Lamai, Maret, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Boutique Three-Bedroom Rooftop-Pavilion Pool Villas, Lamai
blurb: A boutique collection of single-storey tropical villas three minutes from Lamai Beach, framed by coconut groves and mountain views. Three-bedroom homes with a private pool, a rooftop pavilion and landscaped gardens — a limited release in one of Samui's most sought-after areas. Off-plan, from ฿7,500,000 leasehold (฿11,500,000 freehold), with projected returns up to 15%.
detail:
A boutique collection of modern tropical homes just three minutes from Lamai Beach and all the essential amenities, on Koh Samui's south-east coast. Surrounded by lush coconut groves and framed by mountain views, this small, private development blends comfort, privacy and genuine convenience in one of the island's most sought-after areas — with only a limited number of residences available.

Each single-storey villa is designed for easy living: bright, open interiors, elegant architecture that sits naturally in its surroundings, and a private rooftop pavilion for family relaxation and sunset evenings. Homes run to 275 m² of built space on plots of 400–500 m², with three bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms and a private swimming pool.

The specification is thorough — a full-house boiler system, two-car private parking, an automated gate, underground electricity and a private tropical garden, set within green, landscaped common areas and finished to a high standard of construction and craftsmanship. A furniture package is available at ฿1,200,000.

Offered freehold at ฿11,500,000, or leasehold at ฿7,500,000. Freehold ownership is available to Thai nationals or through a Thai company; the leasehold carries a ฿90,000 annual fee, re-evaluated when the lease is extended after 30 years, and is secured with superficies rights. Sold off-plan, with projected net returns of around 15% on the leasehold entry price and 10.7% freehold. Payment schedule, floor plans and specification available on request.
